title: Find every double-charged order in the logs, then fix the cause
prompt:
Support says some customers were charged twice for a single order since Monday 9 March. The payment logs since then are in logs/ (the log rotates, so there is more than one file). Gateway webhooks in the log are the source of truth for what was actually charged.

1. Write DOUBLE_CHARGED.txt in the repo root: the ID of every order that currently has more than one successful charge, one per line, sorted. A charge that was later voided doesn't count; a refund isn't a duplicate.
2. Find the cause in tally/payments.py and fix it so a retry can never charge a card twice. Keep the existing tests passing.
